title: The energy in sunlight took at least tens of thousands of years to get out of the Sun
caption: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach you. Its energy took at least tens of thousands of years to get out.
description: Sunlight reaches you about eight minutes after leaving the Sun's surface. But the energy it carries spent tens of thousands of years, maybe far more, getting out. Estimates include about 40,000 years (NASA SVS), 170,000 (Mitalas & Sills 1992) and about a million (NASA Marshall). The slow part is diffusing out through the Sun's dense interior; in the outer 30%, convection carries it up quickly. It leaves as sunlight.
sources: Mitalas & Sills 1992, "On the Photon Diffusion Time Scale for the Sun", ApJ 401, 759. doi:10.1086/172103
